scientific_integrity: Symbolic all-parameter simplex, incidence, surface-component and Euler-characteristic proof; exact finite cross-checks, not an infinite computational certificate. Earlier odd circular-ladder circle homotopy is explicitly credited.
scientific_limitations: The result is for open Lovász neighborhood complexes of the defined two graph families.
The published odd-circumference circular-ladder homotopy statement was previously known; the PL annulus refinement and other cases comprise the further claim.
Unindexed equivalent PL classifications remain a literature risk.
Independent audit has not been performed.
title: PL surface classification of Lovász neighborhood complexes of Möbius and circular ladders
